def qsort(a):
    if len(a) <= 1:
        return a
    p = a[0]
    left = []
    right = []
    for x in a[1:]:
        if x < p:
            left.append(x)
        else:
            right.append(x)
    r1 = qsort(left)
    print(a, p, left, right, r1)
    r2 = qsort(right)
    print(r1, p, r2)
    return r1 + [p] + r2
print(qsort([8, 3, 9, 1, 5, 5, 2, 7]))
